title: TrọƠi — ERD LV3 ChiTiet (Physical Candidate — PostgreSQL)
purpose: PostgreSQL-oriented physical candidate derived from LV2. It records concrete data types and candidate constraints for review, but is not an approved executable schema.
physical_conventions: Primary identifiers use UUID with gen_random_uuid() in the Lucid candidate.
Flexible snapshots/event payloads use JSONB where shown.
Candidate UNIQUE and CHECK constraints are represented directly in entity definitions.
ORGANIZATION_MEMBER_ROLE separates multi-role membership from ORGANIZATION_MEMBERSHIP.
TRUST_REPORT replaces a generic subject_type/subject_id pair with nullable concrete foreign keys plus an exactly-one-subject CHECK.
AUDIT_EVENT intentionally retains aggregate_type + aggregate_id as an audit-stream reference.

review_notes: This is a physical candidate, not the final schema or a migration.
One-active-tenancy-per-room, one-active-subscription-per-organization, delete/update policies, and index strategy still require explicit review before implementation.
Canvas layout and internal Lucid item IDs are intentionally omitted from this repository snapshot.
This file is not executable and is not a native Lucid import/export format.
